mapper.sql: (source_person.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_share ps JOIN JSON_TABLE(#{orgWorkspaceIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS(id INT PATH '$')) org_workspace ON org_workspace.id = source_person.workspace_id WHERE ps.person_id = source_person.id AND ps.workspace_id = #{workspaceId})) AND source_person.archived_at IS NULL

(target_person.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_share ps JOIN JSON_TABLE(#{orgWorkspaceIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS(id INT PATH '$')) org_workspace ON org_workspace.id = target_person.workspace_id WHERE ps.person_id = target_person.id AND ps.workspace_id = #{workspaceId})) AND target_person.archived_at IS NULL

(c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_share cs JOIN JSON_TABLE(#{orgWorkspaceIdsJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS(id INT PATH '$')) org_workspace ON org_workspace.id = c.workspace_id WHERE cs.company_id = c.id AND cs.workspace_id = #{workspaceId})) AND c.archived_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO person_edge (workspace_id, source_person_id, target_person_id, type, strength, note) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sourcePersonId}, #{targetPersonId}, #{type}, #{strength}, #{note}) AS ne ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = ne.type, strength = ne.strength, note = ne.note

INSERT INTO person_edge (workspace_id, source_person_id, target_person_id, type, strength, note) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sourcePersonId}, #{targetPersonId}, #{type}, #{strength}, #{note}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.sql: SELECT e.id AS id, IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, e.target_person_id, e.source_person_id) AS person_id, IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, target_person.name, source_person.name) AS person_name, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, e.type AS type, e.strength AS strength, e.note AS note, IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, target_person.suspended_at, source_person.suspended_at) AS suspended_at, IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, target_person.provision_ceased_at, source_person.provision_ceased_at) AS provision_ceased_at FROM person_edge e JOIN person source_person ON source_person.id = e.source_person_id AND JOIN person target_person ON target_person.id = e.target_person_id AND LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, target_person.company_id, source_person.company_id) AND WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (e.source_person_id = #{personId} OR e.target_person_id = #{personId})
mapper.select: AND IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, target_person.suspended_at, source_person.suspended_at) IS NULL AND IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, target_person.provision_ceased_at, source_person.provision_ceased_at) IS NULL AND IF(e.source_person_id = #{personId}, target_person.name, source_person.name) REGEXP '[^[:space:]\\x{001C}-\\x{001F}]' ORDER BY e.strength DESC, person_name, person_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.id, e.workspace_id, e.source_person_id, e.target_person_id, e.type, e.strength, e.note, e.created_at FROM person_edge e JOIN person source_person ON source_person.id = e.source_person_id AND JOIN person target_person ON target_person.id = e.target_person_id AND WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND source_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND target_person.suspended_at IS NULL

SELECT e.id FROM person_edge e JOIN person source_person ON source_person.id = e.source_person_id AND JOIN person target_person ON target_person.id = e.target_person_id AND WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND source_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND target_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND e.id IN #{id} ORDER BY e.id

SELECT e.id, e.workspace_id, e.source_person_id, e.target_person_id, e.type, e.strength, e.note, e.created_at FROM person_edge e JOIN person source_person ON source_person.id = e.source_person_id AND JOIN person target_person ON target_person.id = e.target_person_id AND WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND source_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND target_person.suspended_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.id, e.workspace_id, e.source_person_id, e.target_person_id, e.type, e.strength, e.note, e.created_at FROM person_edge e JOIN person source_person ON source_person.id = e.source_person_id AND JOIN person target_person ON target_person.id = e.target_person_id AND WHERE e.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND source_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND target_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND ( e.source_person_id IN #{id} OR e.target_person_id IN #{id} ) ORDER BY e.id LIMIT #{limit}
